records.why: Action commitment is the concept page for ACT committed action; BE012 applies that process to choosing a behaviour that expresses a value.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE012 saturation; quote verified in the opened APA PDF p. 988; target body discusses ACT values-versus-goals work.

records.why: BE012 illustrates values-directed action within ACT's account of psychological flexibility.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE012 saturation; both pages cite the Hayes, Pistorello & Levin 2012 source (citation comparison kept in notes per protocol).

records.why: A values-driven life is behaviour organised around chosen values; BE012 states the working step behind that organisation for a single situation: name what matters, then choose an action that would express it.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE012 saturation; target body discusses values and goals.

records.why: Behavioural activation schedules activities related to goals and values, not only pleasant events; BE017 states the values-first selection rule for what goes on the schedule.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE017 saturation; grounded in the opened Kanter et al. 2010 review.

records.why: Values clarification names the exercise of stating what matters; BE017 is the next step, using the stated values to choose scheduled activities.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE017 saturation; grounded in the opened Kanter et al. 2010 account of BATD value statements suggesting activation assignments.

records.why: Graded task assignment is one of the activation techniques in the BA toolkit; BE015 gives its working rule, sizing each step to what the person can finish.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE015 saturation redo (milestone QC); grounded in the opened Jacobson et al. 2001 and Kanter et al. 2010 accounts of graded task assignment as a BA component.

records.why: Activity scheduling sets what goes on the timetable; BE015 sizes the steps for tasks too large to schedule whole.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE015 saturation redo; both are BA activation techniques in the opened sources.

records.why: Response chaining, described in BE024, is a behavior-analytic teaching procedure.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE024 saturation; grounded in the opened Slocum & Tiger 2011 JABA article.

records.why: Habit formation research describes how routines get triggered by cues; BE024 describes the design move, linking behaviours so an existing routine acts as the reminder for the next.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE024 saturation; grounded in the opened Fogg recipe card's anchor description.

records.why: Sleep deprivation names the cost of poor sleep; BE038 lists the insomnia guideline's behavioural instructions for supporting sleep.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE038 saturation; grounded in the opened Schutte-Rodin et al. 2008 guideline; the earlier 'protects against' wording removed as unverified.

records.why: Temperance, moderating substances and stimulation, is part of the sleep-hygiene instruction list: the guideline says to avoid napping, caffeine, other stimulants, nicotine, alcohol and excessive fluids before bedtime.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE038 saturation; grounded in the opened Schutte-Rodin et al. 2008 guideline, Table 11.

records.why: BE041 examines nature contact through an experiment measuring rumination after natural and urban walks.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE041 saturation; target body discusses nature contact among lifestyle interventions.

records.why: TIPP's muscle-relaxation step is a clinical application of the tense-release technique BE047 describes.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE047 saturation; target body verified to discuss muscle relaxation.

records.why: Prosocial behaviour is the umbrella term for actions that benefit others; BE056 covers the kindness-intervention subset and the meta-analytic evidence on the actor's well-being.
records.notes: Proposed by worker-p1ze-e6d6f5ba during BE056 saturation; grounded in the opened Curry et al. 2018 meta-analysis.

records.why: BE069 names depression's withdrawal and inactivity as the behaviours behavioral activation targets; the concept page covers the treatment's account of those patterns.
